sentences.back: A makerspace is an interesting room for new technology.
People go there to make things.
A 3D printer is a cool tool in this room.
First, you make a design on a computer.
The computer tells the printer what to shape.
Then the printer works in a special way.
Traditional manufacturing is cutting big pieces of material small.
But 3D printing builds things from the bottom up.
The machine lays down thin lines of hot plastic.
It adds one layer on top of another.
The plastic cools quickly and hardens.
Soon, a new toy or cup is made!
